title: Payer Eligibility Checks and Coverage Status — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Verification policy.** Every Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility coverage record is checked with the payer when it is added. An equipment rental month, supply shipment or delivery may be billed to a record only when its last eligibility check date is no more than the class's eligibility refresh period (in calendar days) before the date of service; an older check is refreshed with a new eligibility check first.

## Status moves from a payer response

| Payer response | Record status before | Record status after |
|---|---|---|
| active | pending verification | active |
| inactive | pending verification | not eligible |
| terminated | active | terminated, with the payer's termination date |

## Ending coverage

Coverage is ended only from the payer's eligibility response or written notice, never from the patient's statement alone: a coverage record is terminated only when an eligibility check on it returned terminated. That check is read from the eligibility responses recorded on that same coverage record.

A patient who reports new insurance has the new record added and checked; the old record stays active until its own check returns terminated.

## Freshness boundary (hypothetical dates)

Take a class whose refresh period is 30 calendar days and a rental month whose date of service is day D.

| Last eligibility check date | Days before day D | May the month be billed on that check? |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days before D | 30 | yes — no more than 30 |
| 31 days before D | 31 | no — the check is refreshed first |

## Points of judgement

- A patient telephones to say a plan ended last month. The statement alone does not terminate the record; the record is terminated when an eligibility check on it returns terminated.
- A new card is reported and its record added. The old record remains active until its own eligibility check returns terminated.
